title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 10: the strange fire of Nadab and Abihu, the rules for the priests and the question of the sin offering.

questions.text: Which sons of Aaron offered strange fire before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, put fire and incense in their censers and offered strange fire before Yahweh, which he had not commanded them.

questions.text: What happened to the two sons who offered strange fire?
questions.explanation: Fire came out from before Yahweh and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.

answers.text: They were sent out of the camp
Fire from Yahweh devoured them and they died
They lost their priesthood but lived

questions.text: How did Aaron respond when Moses told him what Yahweh had spoken?
questions.explanation: After Moses' words about Yahweh showing himself holy, Aaron held his peace.

answers.text: He left the Tent of Meeting

questions.text: Whom did Moses call to carry the dead men out of the camp?
questions.explanation: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, to carry their brothers out of the camp.

questions.text: What were Aaron, Eleazar and Ithamar told not to do in their mourning?
questions.explanation: Moses told them not to let the hair of their heads go loose and not to tear their clothes, so that they would not die.

answers.text: Eat any bread or drink any water that day
Speak to the people of the congregation
Light the lamps of the Tent of Meeting
Let their hair go loose or tear their clothes

questions.text: What were Aaron and his sons not to drink when they went into the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said they were not to drink wine or strong drink when they went into the Tent of Meeting, or they would die.

questions.text: Between what were the priests to make a distinction?
questions.explanation: They were to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

answers.text: The rich and the poor, the old and the young
Israelites and strangers, servants and masters
The holy and the common, the unclean and the clean
Men and women, firstborn and younger sons

questions.text: Besides Aaron and his sons, who could eat the waved breast and the heaved thigh?
questions.explanation: Aaron, his sons and his daughters with him were to eat the waved breast and heaved thigh in a clean place.

questions.text: What had happened to the goat of the sin offering when Moses inquired about it?
questions.explanation: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and it had been burned; he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar.

answers.text: It had been given to the people

questions.text: How did Moses respond to Aaron's explanation at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: When Moses heard Aaron's answer, it was pleasing in his sight.

answers.text: It was pleasing in his sight
He ordered a new sin offering
